comparison.objective: Sort glasses into a rack and stack plates largest-first in a bus tub.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated cross-midline handoffs, upright placement, and ordered stacking.
comparison.success_condition: Correct containers and plate order with no tipped or dropped item; any mis-sort or instability scores zero.
comparison.reason: Tests sorting, handoffs, and stacking rather than controlled fracture tooling or retrieval of millimetre metal fragments.
